## 11\. FAQs \- MBA and Bachelor’s in Denmark
Q1. Can I study MBA in Denmark after 12th?
Naw. Typically, for admission to an MBA, you will need a bachelor’s degree and to meet the programme’s requirements for professional experience.
Q2. Is work experience needed for an MBA in Denmark?
Work experience is a prerequisite for many MBA programs. Minimums differ by institution.
Q3. What is the duration to complete an MBA in Denmark?
Some full-time programs are about one year, other formats can take longer.
Q4. What is the cost of studying MBA in Denmark?
Tuition varies greatly. The tuition fee for some of the chosen programs could be in the range of ₹17-50 lakh, excluding the living expenses.
Some institutions offer scholarships or financial assistance to eligible candidates, but these vary in availability and eligibility. Please check the official program website before applying.
